skill_route.resolution: The mission-approved production registry entry and TC-FF6-MACH-001 bind complete ProductContract obligation slices to format-feature-expansion. The historical reconciler's metadata-complete label was rejected because generic dictionary roundtrip did not provide typed access, validation of known namespaces, or evidence for the named metadata obligations.

requested_operation: implement lossless typed metadata adapters for notebook kernelspec and language info, cell tags, slideshow and execution timing, and per-MIME output rendering metadata

inputs.root_cause: The codec preserved raw metadata dictionaries, but there was no typed or validated access for the contract's common metadata namespaces. A presence-based reconciler mapped generic roundtrip behavior to several distinct metadata obligations and therefore hid missing behavior.
inputs.affected_layer: IPYNB typed model views, public API, forward-compatible preservation guarantees, error behavior, and package documentation

observations: The failure-first test could not collect because format_factory.ipynb exported no MetadataShapeError or metadata adapter.

Existing generic load/dump behavior retained raw dictionaries but could not expose or validate kernelspec, language_info, tags, slideshow, execution, or per-MIME output metadata as named typed concepts.
The new focused matrix exercises a real repository notebook plus unknown nested vendor data and malformed known namespaces.

implementation.compatibility: Existing raw metadata access and load/dump behavior is unchanged; all metadata adapters and symbols are additive in the pre-1.0 public namespace.
implementation.snapshot_model: Each adapter deep-copies its input once and returns defensive copies from to_dict and extras. Callers cannot accidentally mutate a notebook through a typed view.
implementation.notebook_metadata: Kernelspec and language-info snapshots expose their defined common fields and retain all additional members exactly.
implementation.cell_metadata: Tags are returned as an immutable tuple and enforce the nbformat uniqueness and comma restrictions. Slideshow and execution timing namespaces have typed views with unknown-member retention.
implementation.output_metadata: Per-MIME rendering metadata is exposed separately from non-MIME extension namespaces and retains nested values exactly.
implementation.failure_behavior: Malformed known namespaces fail with MetadataShapeError instead of being silently interpreted as absent or normalized away.
implementation.forward_preservation: Unknown notebook, known-namespace, cell, and output metadata remains byte-value-equivalent at the Python data-model level and survives serialization.
implementation.tradeoff: Adapters are immutable snapshots rather than live mutation facades. Snapshot creation is linear in the selected metadata subtree and consumes an equivalent temporary copy; this intentionally prioritizes isolation and preservation safety. Typed metadata mutation remains explicit raw-model work until a separately governed edit API is implemented.
